label: v3-student-1
pipeline: V3/compose film (story with a setting block, one paragraph per clip; each clip = case 1 or 3 with setting + paragraph + guide)
brief: A short film in three clips, widescreen, about 15 seconds each: a high-school student gets a test back with a bad score and two classmates mock him for it; that night he studies alone at his desk; the next test comes back with a high score, the same classmates see it, and he quietly smiles.

llm.name: v3-film-story-v1
llm.purpose: the story: setting block + one paragraph per clip

story.setting: Present-day autumn, over one school week in a quiet suburban town. The second-floor classroom has cream walls, east windows facing a paved courtyard, and desks in rows. Evan sits beside the windows; Maya and Leo sit at the neighboring desks, close enough to see his paper. Morning light falls across the desktops, while the corridor beyond the classroom door stays dim. The upstairs bedroom has pale blue walls, one window facing a quiet street, and a wooden desk beneath it. It sits above the family kitchen, away from the school; at night, the window reflects the desk lamp rather than the street. Evan has short black hair, a navy hoodie, and round glasses. Maya has a dark ponytail, a mustard cardigan, and silver stud earrings. Leo has curly brown hair, a gray sweatshirt, and a red wristband. Keep these clothes and details unchanged. The film uses naturalistic light, restrained contrast, and a softly muted grade: cool classroom mornings, warm lamplight at night, with no exaggerated change in color when Evan succeeds.

story.title: The Next Paper

places.look: The second-floor classroom has cream walls, east windows facing a paved courtyard, and desks in rows.
The upstairs bedroom has pale blue walls, one window facing a quiet street, and a wooden desk beneath it.

clips.paragraph: The second-floor classroom has cream walls, east windows facing a paved courtyard, and desks in rows. Begin in a medium shot of Evan beside the windows. Evan has short black hair, a navy hoodie, and round glasses. He turns over his returned test. Cut close: “38/100” is clear; other marks are indistinct. Maya has a dark ponytail, a mustard cardigan, and silver stud earrings. Leo has curly brown hair, a gray sweatshirt, and a red wristband. Maya leans over and points at the score. Leo looks, smirks, and nudges Maya; she covers a mocking grin. Evan lowers his eyes and pulls the paper toward himself. End close on his hand covering the score.

The upstairs bedroom has pale blue walls, one window facing a quiet street, and a wooden desk beneath it. It is night. Evan has short black hair, a navy hoodie, and round glasses. Begin in a medium side view: he sits alone under a warm desk lamp, with an open textbook and notebook before him. The page markings are not readable. He follows a textbook example with one finger, then writes in the notebook. Cut closer as he stops, rubs out a line, checks the example, and writes again. He lowers his face toward the page and continues. End on his moving pencil beneath the steady pool of lamplight.

The second-floor classroom has cream walls, east windows facing a paved courtyard, and desks in rows. One week later, begin close as Evan turns over his next returned test: “94/100” is clear; other marks are indistinct. Evan has short black hair, a navy hoodie, and round glasses. Widen to the neighboring desks. Maya has a dark ponytail, a mustard cardigan, and silver stud earrings. Leo has curly brown hair, a gray sweatshirt, and a red wristband. Maya looks at the score and touches Leo’s sleeve. Leo looks too; neither grins. Evan leaves the paper uncovered, raises his eyes briefly toward them, then looks down. End close on his quiet, closed-mouth smile.
